description:
EI Mob Access is a secure mobile access control application that allows users to use their smartphone as a digital ID card. The app communicates with ESP32-based access reader devices using Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) to enable quick and convenient entry to authorized areas.

With INS Mob Access, users no longer need to carry a physical ID card. Simply use your mobile device to authenticate with the access reader and gain entry securely.

Key Features

Mobile ID Access

Use your smartphone as a digital access card to authenticate with compatible ESP32 reader devices.

Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) Communication

The app uses BLE technology to communicate securely with nearby access readers.

Contactless Access

Simply bring your mobile device near the reader to verify your identity and gain access.

Secure Authentication

Designed to support secure communication between the mobile device and access reader.

Fast and Convenient

Eliminates the need for physical cards, making access control faster and easier.

How It Works

Install and open EI Mob Access on your mobile device.

Enable Bluetooth on your device.

Approach a compatible ESP32 access reader.

The app communicates with the reader and verifies your access credentials.

If authorized, access will be granted.

Permissions

The application may request the following permissions to provide its functionality:

Bluetooth / Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)

Required to communicate with ESP32-based reader devices.

Nearby Devices / Location (Required by Android for BLE scanning)

Used only to detect nearby access readers.

These permissions are used solely for communication with authorized access reader devices.

Security and Privacy

EI Mob Access is designed with user privacy in mind. The application does not collect or store personal user data. All communication occurs locally between the mobile device and the ESP32 reader device.

Ideal For

Office access control

Workplace security systems

Smart building access

Employee mobile ID solutions

Developed By

Eirfid Solutions

description:
Military-related Persian-Farsi phrases for language learners. With Persian-Farsi text and audio.

Using this app, you can select an English phrase and view its translation and how to pronounce it in Persian-Farsi.

This app was originally developed as an entry to the 2010 CIO/G6 "Apps for the Army" competition, and it is based on the modules publicly available online from the U.S. Defense Language Institute. While this app's subject matter relates mainly to military topics, the app is broadly useful with content relating to a range of topics.

• Contains over 600 phrases with native speaker audio recordings

• Dictionary lookup: Type or say what you want to search

• Pronunciation help: See the transliterated/Romanized text

• Good for language learning, or as a reference

This app is part of a series of phrasebook apps published for many different languages and dialects. Phrasebooks in the series are available as "basic" and "medical" variants.

• Text may be exported as Anki flash cards

• Works offline: No network connection is required

• Search bar for quick vocabulary lookup

• No login or registration needed

• Dark background color minimizes eye strain

Many of the languages covered by this series of phrasebook apps are under-resourced, with translation apps and dictionaries not widely available from other sources.

Categories

Commands, Warnings and Instructions

Helpful Words, Phrases and Questions

Greetings and Introductions

Interrogation

Numbers

Days of the Week/Time

Directions

Locations

Descriptions (Colors, Shapes, Sizes, Tastes, Qualities, Quantities)

Emergency Terms

Food and Sanitation

Fuel and Maintenance

Medical Terms/General

Medical Terms/Parts of the Body

Military Ranks

Lodging

Occupations

Customs (Port of Entry)

Relatives

Weather

General Military Terms

Mine Warfare Terms

How to use

1. Choose a subject category from the menu. That category will be expanded.

2. From the expanded list of phrases shown, tap on the phrase you want.

3. On the phrase detail page, the Persian-Farsi phrase is shown alongside its pronunciation and the equivalent English phrase. Press the Play button to hear the audio pronunciation by a native speaker.

Ideal for

• U.S. military service members

• Doctors, nurses, and medical professionals

• Travelers

• Aid workers

• Linguists

Languages and dialects available in this series

Albanian, Algerian, Amharic, Azeri, Baluchi, Bengali, Bosnian, Burmese, Cantonese, Cebuano, Chavacano, Croatian, Czech, Dari, Egyptian, Emirati, French, Gan (Jiangxinese), Georgian, Gujarati, Haitian, Hassaniya, Hausa, Hebrew, Hindi, Igbo, Ilocano, Indonesian (Bahasa), Iraqi, Japanese, Javanese, Jordanian, Kashmiri, Kazakh, Khmer, Korean (North), Kosovar (Albanian), Kurmanji, Kyrgyz, Lebanese, Libyan, Lingala, Malay, Mandarin, Mongolian, Moroccan, Nepali, Palestinian, Pashto (Afghanistan), Pashto (Pakistan), Persian-Farsi, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese (Europe), Punjabi, Quechua, Russian, Saudi, Serbian, Sindhi, Somali, Sorani, Spanish (Colombia), Spanish (Mexico), Spanish (Venezuela), Sudanese, Swahili, Syrian, Tagalog, Tajik, Tamashek, Tamil, Tausug, Telugu, Thai, Tigrinya, Tunisian, Turkish, Turkmen, Uighur, Ukrainian, Urdu, Uzbek, Vietnamese, Shanghainese, Yakan, Yemeni, Yoruba

description:
Military-related Nepali phrases for language learners. With Nepali text and audio.

Using this app, you can select an English phrase and view its translation and how to pronounce it in Nepali.

This app was originally developed as an entry to the 2010 CIO/G6 "Apps for the Army" competition, and it is based on the modules publicly available online from the U.S. Defense Language Institute. While this app's subject matter relates mainly to military topics, the app is broadly useful with content relating to a range of topics.

• Contains over 600 phrases with native speaker audio recordings

• Dictionary lookup: Type or say what you want to search

• Pronunciation help: See the transliterated/Romanized text

• Good for language learning, or as a reference

This app is part of a series of phrasebook apps published for many different languages and dialects. Phrasebooks in the series are available as "basic" and "medical" variants.

• Text may be exported as Anki flash cards

• Works offline: No network connection is required

• Search bar for quick vocabulary lookup

• No login or registration needed

• Dark background color minimizes eye strain

Many of the languages covered by this series of phrasebook apps are under-resourced, with translation apps and dictionaries not widely available from other sources.

Categories

Commands, Warnings and Instructions

Helpful Words, Phrases and Questions

Greetings and Introductions

Interrogation

Numbers

Days of the Week/Time

Directions

Locations

Descriptions (Colors, Shapes, Sizes, Tastes, Qualities, Quantities)

Emergency Terms

Food and Sanitation

Fuel and Maintenance

Medical Terms/General

Medical Terms/Parts of the Body

Military Ranks

Lodging

Occupations

Customs (Port of Entry)

Relatives

Weather

General Military Terms

Mine Warfare Terms

How to use

1. Choose a subject category from the menu. That category will be expanded.

2. From the expanded list of phrases shown, tap on the phrase you want.

3. On the phrase detail page, the Nepali phrase is shown alongside its pronunciation and the equivalent English phrase. Press the Play button to hear the audio pronunciation by a native speaker.

Ideal for

• U.S. military service members

• Doctors, nurses, and medical professionals

• Travelers

• Aid workers

• Linguists

Languages and dialects available in this series

Albanian, Algerian, Amharic, Azeri, Baluchi, Bengali, Bosnian, Burmese, Cantonese, Cebuano, Chavacano, Croatian, Czech, Dari, Egyptian, Emirati, French, Gan (Jiangxinese), Georgian, Gujarati, Haitian, Hassaniya, Hausa, Hebrew, Hindi, Igbo, Ilocano, Indonesian (Bahasa), Iraqi, Japanese, Javanese, Jordanian, Kashmiri, Kazakh, Khmer, Korean (North), Kosovar (Albanian), Kurmanji, Kyrgyz, Lebanese, Libyan, Lingala, Malay, Mandarin, Mongolian, Moroccan, Nepali, Palestinian, Pashto (Afghanistan), Pashto (Pakistan), Persian-Farsi, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese (Europe), Punjabi, Quechua, Russian, Saudi, Serbian, Sindhi, Somali, Sorani, Spanish (Colombia), Spanish (Mexico), Spanish (Venezuela), Sudanese, Swahili, Syrian, Tagalog, Tajik, Tamashek, Tamil, Tausug, Telugu, Thai, Tigrinya, Tunisian, Turkish, Turkmen, Uighur, Ukrainian, Urdu, Uzbek, Vietnamese, Shanghainese, Yakan, Yemeni, Yoruba

Making flash cards: Launch app and choose "Flash cards" from the menu in the top corner, and follow the prompts.

Materials in this app are adapted from publications authored by the Defense Language Institute Foreign Language Center (www.dliflc.edu). This app is not affiliated with DLIFLC or any other government or military organization.

description:
SNAPmobile is a SIP softclient that extends VoIP functionality beyond the land line or desk top. It brings features of the netsapiens platform directly to end-user's mobile devices as a Unified Communications solution. With SNAPmobile, users are able to maintain the same identity when making or receiving calls from any location, regardless of their device. They are also able seamlessly send an ongoing call from one device to another and continue that call without interruption. SNAPmobile grants users the ability to manage contacts, voicemail, call history and configurations in a single location. This includes the management of answering rules. greetings, and presence which all contribute to more efficient communication.

We utilise foreground services to ensure uninterrupted calling functionality within the app. This is essential to maintain seamless communication even when the app is running in the background, preventing microphone disconnection during calls.

To communicate with the developers, please email mobile-engineering@netsapiens.com or post on our forums at http://alphaforum.netsapiens.com/

***NOTICE: You must have a an existing account with a supported service provider in order for SNAPmobile to work***

description:
FacePro supports teams that need reliable communication across offices, factories, and remote sites. It suits quick check ins as well as scheduled sessions, so distributed staff can align without travel. The app focuses on secure conversations and clear audio and video, even when connections vary. With a design for enterprise workflows, it handles moderated discussions and training use cases. For users who install on Android, the FacePro APK offers a consistent setup experience.


Key features for enterprise meetings

Multiparty meetings at scale

FacePro uses an MCU architecture to run smooth multiparty calls with up to 300 participants. Large FacePro Video Conference sessions remain stable, even when the network is limited. This helps teams move from quick huddles to larger, moderated meetings without changing tools.

Encrypted and controlled access

FacePro protects confidential communications with AES 256 bit encryption and SSL transport. Role based access control helps you define who can host, join, moderate, and share content. This structure supports compliance needs while keeping everyday use straightforward.

Tools to collaborate in real time

During a meeting, you can use group chat, desktop or screen sharing, an interactive whiteboard, and multi screen display. These tools make it easier to show procedures, annotate steps, and keep everyone on the same page. Teams can switch between tools as the conversation progresses.

Moderation, recording and broadcasting

Chairman controls and conference management give hosts clear oversight of a session. Recording and live broadcasting support trainings and events where content needs to be captured or shared widely. Hosts can adjust permissions to match the format and audience.

High fidelity media and smart glasses support

Ultra HD 4K video and HD voice provide clear visuals and sound for face to face conversations. FacePro works across Android and Windows and integrates with FacePro Xpert System to guide field technicians hands free on compatible smart glasses. This approach supports remote inspections, maintenance, and assembly with expert oversight.


Planning FacePro deployment

Before rolling out FacePro, define meeting roles and policies for recording and broadcasting. Confirm which teams can host, moderate, or present, and communicate those rules to participants. Align the setup with internal security standards and governance practices.

For field operations, review smart glasses compatibility and integration steps with FacePro Xpert System. Establish procedures for remote inspections, maintenance, and assembly, including who provides expert support and how sessions are documented for later review.

For large events and trainings, plan participant limits, registration, and moderation settings in advance. Test the network at venues and job sites to maintain predictable quality and reduce the chance of disruptions.


How to use FacePro on Android

After you download FacePro, set up your account to join meetings. The app supports secure, role based sessions for business use. Follow these steps on an Android phone.

  1. Open FacePro and sign in with your company account. If your organization provides a meeting link, keep it ready.
  2. Next, check your camera and microphone, and run a quick test call to confirm audio and video.
  3. Then create or join a meeting using a link or meeting ID from your team. If you host, set chairman controls and permissions before participants arrive.
  4. During the session, use chat, screen sharing, and the whiteboard to present information. Switch to multi screen display when you need to compare content.
  5. Finally, start recording or broadcasting if required and permitted by your organization. End the meeting and save any shared notes or files.


Get started with FacePro

FacePro delivers secure meetings with practical tools for collaboration and moderation. It supports enterprise discussions, trainings, and field guidance with clear audio and video. Install the FacePro latest version to begin.

For official resources, visit:

  • Official website: https://www.fpxpert.cn/

description:
PVADeals rents you a non-VoIP phone number in the United States or the United Kingdom so you can receive SMS verification codes without giving out your personal number. Rent one for twenty minutes or for a month, read your codes in the app, and let it go when you're done.

Every number is non-VoIP — a real mobile-network line, not an internet number.

WHY RENT A NUMBER

• Keep your personal number off sign-up forms, marketing lists and data brokers.

• Give your team a shared line instead of routing verification through someone's personal handset.

• Test your own sign-up and one-time-passcode flows on real US and UK numbers.

• Use a second number on marketplace and classifieds listings, so buyers never reach your personal line.

RENT FOR TWENTY MINUTES OR THIRTY DAYS

• Short term: a number held for 20 minutes, for a single verification.

• Long term: 3, 7, 14 or 30 days. Upgrade to a longer term mid-rental, or switch on auto-renew and keep the number.

• All Services: one number with no website to choose, valid 28 days in the US and 30 days in the UK.

• Cover up to 5 websites in a single purchase.

• Renting in the US? Pick your region — over 300 area codes across 440 cities.

• Every website shows a live stock count before you buy.

YOUR CODES, AS THEY ARRIVE

• The number's screen updates by itself while the rental is live. No refreshing, no buying a second number.

• A chime sounds the moment a code lands.

• Tap the number or the code to copy it.

• Get a push notification for every new message, and open straight to it.

• If a code turns up from a site you didn't order for, the app says so — and offers to switch you across where that site is supported.

WHEN SOMETHING GOES WRONG

• If your 20-minute number receives nothing, the charge comes back automatically. You don't have to ask.

• Flag a number in two taps — SMS didn't arrive, number already used, or ordered by mistake.

• Open a support ticket in the app and keep the whole conversation in one thread, with a status you can see at a glance.

• Numbers that finish can often be reactivated for another code, when the provider still allows it.

FOR DEVELOPERS

• A documented REST API for buying numbers, reading codes and flagging.

• An API key you can view and rotate yourself, protected by your device biometric.

• Point a webhook at your own service and have incoming codes pushed to you.

• A remote MCP endpoint, so an AI agent can check your balance, browse services, buy a number and read its codes using the same key.

YOUR ACCOUNT

• Sign in with email or with Google, and add a password later if you started with Google.

• Account credit with a running balance, and a full history of every deposit and every number.

• Set a low-balance alert and get an email before you run out.

• Choose exactly which notifications you want: new codes, ticket replies, ticket updates, news.

• Light and dark themes, following your device by default.

ABOUT YOUR PRIVACY

PVADeals never reads the messages on your own phone. The app asks for no SMS permission and no access to your call log or contacts — it requests internet access, and your device biometric only to protect your API key. Codes arrive on the number you rented and are shown in the app.

Rented numbers are temporary by design. A rental ends when its term ends, and delivery depends on the site sending the code and the networks in between, so codes cannot be guaranteed to arrive — which is why an empty short-term rental refunds itself and why flagging exists.

Smart24 is personal safety and communications app, helping to keep dispersed workforces and travellers safe and secure by connecting them with a monitoring team.

When needed, you can continuously share your location in real time with your monitoring team, helping to speed up the process of coordinating an effective response during an emergency.

Smart24 allows you to trigger emergency alerts, send one off location check ins, and communicate with your monitoring team using secure two-way messaging and push notifications.

It includes a Shake for Emergency feature, allowing to quickly notify your monitoring team about an emergency, even when the phone is locked, by shaking your phone with a special gesture.

Sometimes in response to a new threat or disruption, or if you have lost your phone, your monitoring team may need to quickly know where you are. So Smart24 features a Poll Location feature, where your monitoring team can obtain your location when the app is running in the background. You receive a notification when this happens and this feature is controlled by you.

We know that sharing your location, even with trusted people like your monitoring team, can be a concern, so we have carefully designed Smart24 to respect privacy.

Kevin De Bruyne (born 28 June 1991) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Manchester City and the Belgium national team. He is widely regarded as one of the best midfielders in the world and of his generation. Pundits have often described him as a "complete footballer".

De Bruyne began his career at Genk, where he was a regular player when they won the 2010–11 Belgian Pro League. In 2012 he joined English club Chelsea, where he was used sparingly and then loaned to Werder Bremen. He signed with Wolfsburg for £18 million in 2014, where he established himself as one of the best players in the Bundesliga and was integral in the club's 2014–15 DFB-Pokal win. In the summer of 2015 De Bruyne joined Manchester City for a club record £54 million. He has since won four Premier League titles, five League Cups and an FA Cup with the club. In 2017–18 he had a significant role in Manchester City's record in becoming the only Premier League team to attain 100 points in a single season. In 2019–20, De Bruyne tied the record for most assists in a Premier League season and was awarded Player of the Season (which he won again in 2021–22).

De Bruyne made his full international debut in 2010, and he has since earned over 90 caps and scored 24 goals for Belgium. He was a member of the Belgian squads that reached the quarter-finals both at the 2014 FIFA World Cup and at UEFA Euro 2016. He represented Belgium at the 2018 FIFA World Cup, where Belgium won the third place play-off match against England, and was named in the FIFA World Cup Dream Team.

Android 11 & above :

Android 10 :

No Change.

description:
Bring your messages and home screen together with Messages: Text Messenger Home. Send SMS and MMS, organize conversations and open your apps from a customizable Android home launcher.

This app combines messaging with a replacement home screen. Setup asks you to choose Messages Home as your default Home app. To send, receive and manage texts, also choose it as your default SMS app when prompted. Change default apps later in Android Settings.

ORGANIZE YOUR INBOX

Search conversations, pin important threads and archive chats to keep them outside the main inbox. Browse All, Personal, OTP, Transactions, Promotions and Updates categories. On-device rules use message previews and sender details; classifications are not guaranteed. Copy recognized verification codes from supported messages.

WRITE AND SHARE

Send text messages to phone numbers and choose recipients from your contacts when you allow contact access. Use the attachment controls for photos, videos, audio and contact details. You can also insert a location link after allowing location access. Attachments are sent using the messaging services supported by your device and carrier; this is not an internet chat or RCS service.

PLAN A MESSAGE

Choose a future date and time when composing a message, then find pending messages in Scheduled. Send a queued message now, copy its text or remove it. Scheduled sending depends on the phone being available, the required Android settings and permissions, and carrier service. Exact delivery times are not guaranteed.

MANAGE UNWANTED CONVERSATIONS

Block selected numbers or conversations using the app's blocking controls. Review blocked entries and unblock them when needed. Blocking is based on your choices; the app does not promise to identify every spam message or protect against all scams.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR HOME

Use the app drawer to search and launch installed apps. Add app shortcuts to Home, arrange icons and organize shortcuts into folders. Adjust icon size, label visibility, text size, drawer columns and background appearance. Open wallpaper settings and add supported widgets from apps installed on your phone. Availability depends on the apps and device. The Home message panel provides a shortcut to your inbox and shows message information when access is available.

BACK UP AND RESTORE SMS

Choose a backup folder using Android's file picker and create an SMS backup file. Select a compatible backup to restore messages, review the file information and confirm before importing. Restore progress is shown in the app and through a foreground-service notification, with an option to stop the restore. Keep backup files somewhere you trust: exported backups contain message content and are not encrypted by this app. Backup and restore currently support SMS only, not MMS or automatic scheduled backups.

ACCESS AND PRIVACY

No app account is required. SMS access enables core messaging, contact access helps display names and select recipients, and notification permission supports message alerts and restore progress. Location access is used when you choose the location attachment. The launcher reads launchable installed apps to build its app drawer.

Inbox categorization and SMS backup processing take place on your device. The app also includes Google Mobile Ads, Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics for advertising, usage measurement and crash diagnostics. Ad availability depends on configuration, eligibility and privacy choices. Do not treat local message processing as a claim that the app collects no data.

BEFORE YOU START

SMS/MMS require a compatible device, SIM and mobile plan. Carrier messaging and data charges may apply. MMS support and delivery depend on carrier configuration. This app does not provide end-to-end encrypted internet messaging, online presence or remote read-status tracking.

"Live Without Bullying" App provides anonymous and free online counseling, in the form of chat, about the phenomenon of school and internet bullying.

The services are aimed at:

• Children aged 10 to 18 who have suffered or are threatened with school or internet intimidation or want to help a friend / classmate but are not aware of the way.

• Parents and teachers who want to help their child or student

How does it work;

Are you 10-18 years old and are you having a bullying problem or are you trying to help a friend who is in trouble?

1. Make a quick and anonymous sign up! Username, Password and a valid email is enough!

2. Send a message and explain your problem.

3. The first available consultant will see you and your conversation will begin.

4. If you are offline when the consultant answers you, you will be notified by phone and email that you have received an answer.

5. Set up with the counselor the day and time that you can both talk back to the app again so that the counselor can see the appointment in your calendar through the app's functionality. To remind you of the appointment, you will be given the appropriate notice.

Are you a parent or teacher and are you worried about your child or student? Do you want to help your child or student and need support?

1. Make a quick and anonymous subscription

2. Send a message about the problem you are experiencing.

4. You will receive a personal response (message) from the first available consultant who will then be able to continue the discussion on the matter you are concerned with. Whenever you receive a response from our consultant, you will receive a notification on your email and mobile phone.

"Live Without Bullying" consultants are specially trained in providing school and internet bullying counseling and want to listen to you to find solutions together!

Remember…

There are solutions, as long as you speak!

"Live Without Bullying" App is part of the Live Without Bullying program to prevent and deal with bullying.

The Live Without Bullying program is an integrated program to prevent and combat school and internet bullying for children aged 10-18 and adults (parents or educators) and implemented by the Child and Child Care Center (KMOP)

Through the online platform www.livewithoutbullying.com 10 to 18 year olds and adults, parents and teachers affected by intimidation can get free counseling and information services tailored to their particular needs.

Online services are flanked by awareness raising campaigns and educational programs for pupils and teachers in schools (with the approval of the Ministry of Education) as well as on-line through the KMOP e-learning application.

description:
No internet. No cell tower. Still connected.

Mesh Chat is a messaging app that works by connecting directly to the phones around you. No server, no SIM card, no Wi-Fi network, no mobile data. Your messages never touch the internet — they travel device to device.

▍HOW IT WORKS

Mesh Chat uses Bluetooth and Wi-Fi Direct to automatically find other Mesh Chat users nearby and form a direct network with them. When the person you're messaging is out of range, the devices in between pass it along for you. The network grows as more people join.

▍WORKS WITH ANDROID AND iPHONE

Android and iOS devices join the same mesh and message each other freely — including in a mixed relay chain, where an Android hands a message to an iPhone, which hands it to the next Android. Text, private messages, images and location all work across platforms.

▍END-TO-END ENCRYPTION

Private messages are encrypted before they leave your phone and can only be opened on the recipient's device. Every connection generates single-use session keys (forward secrecy): when the session ends those keys are destroyed, so past messages cannot be unlocked later — even if your device is compromised afterwards.

• Every message is digitally signed and verified on arrival

• Your identity keys never leave your device

• Protection against replay attacks

• No account, no phone number, no access to your contacts

• No cloud backup, no message servers

▍FEATURES

Public Chat

Broadcast to every Mesh Chat user in range. Ideal for events, camping trips, festivals and crowded venues.

Private Chat

End-to-end encrypted one-to-one messaging with the person you choose.

Multi-Hop Relay

If a message can't reach someone directly, it hops through the devices in between to get there.

Automatic Peer Discovery

Nearby users are found and connected in the background, automatically.

Delivery Tracking

Connected node count, pending queue and delivery confirmations are visible at a glance. Messages that don't get through are retried automatically.

Image Sharing (Premium)

Photos are compressed automatically and delivered encrypted, piece by piece.

Emergency Broadcast (Premium)

Send a high-priority message that is clearly marked on every screen it reaches. You can attach your coordinates if you choose to.

Battery-Aware Operation

The background service adapts how often it scans based on your battery level.

Available in English and Turkish.

▍WHEN IT HELPS

• Where there's power but no internet

• Hiking, camping, climbing and rural areas

• Festivals, concerts and stadiums where the network is overloaded

• In airplane mode, abroad, or when you're out of data

• Coordinating with a group that's nearby but offline

▍PREMIUM

One single purchase, no subscription. Removes ads and unlocks image sharing, emergency location and a custom display name. Buy it once, keep it forever.

▍PLEASE READ BEFORE YOU RELY ON IT

Mesh Chat is a peer-to-peer tool built on Bluetooth and Wi-Fi Direct, and those technologies have real limits you should understand:

• Range depends on your surroundings. Walls, crowds and interference shorten it significantly.

• Delivery is not guaranteed. A message only arrives if a chain of devices running Mesh Chat is close enough to carry it.

• Every relaying device needs the app running for the chain to work.

• Continuous scanning uses more battery than a normal messaging app.

• Mesh Chat is not a replacement for emergency services. Always call your local emergency number first when help is available.

Mesh Chat is best understood as an extra way to reach people when the usual ones aren't there — not as a guarantee that you always will.

description:
CTECH Radio is an all-in-one mission critical communications powerhouse that connects people in a variety of ways in a wide range of situations. Its capabilities comprise voice and video calls, messaging, tracking (including indoor localization), task management and more. The uses of the app are versatile. For some users, it helps ensure smooth operation of their business. For others, it's part of the security toolset. Importantly, it can be vital in responding to dangerous incidents where lives depend on timely communication. Whether you're a logistics specialist, a guard on patrol, a firefighter or a police officer, you will appreciate the reliable power of CTECH Radio, its focus and ease of use.

This app is the client-side component of the PrioCom framework. CTECH Radiovides mission critical push-to-talk (MC-PTT) capabilities in LTE networks over the Internet Protocol (IP) and builds a comprehensive communications and emergency response solution on that foundation. The following are some highlights of the PrioCom features that CTECH Radio implements.

Voice communication features

Call capabilities are at the heart of mission-critical communications. In addition to the obligatory group and individual calls, CTECH Radio offers an extended set of voice and video call types.

• Individual, group and channel calls

• Emergency calls

• Priority calls

• Video calls

• Offline user calls

• Voice recording and playback

Messaging features

In situations where voice communication is not your first choice of format, use free-form or template-based text messages, or send arbitrary files over your PrioCom network.

• Text and file exchange

• Template-based status messages

Lone worker protection features

Intended for ensuring the safety of employees who are working in hazardous conditions, these features rely on sensor and battery charge data. These readings can indicate emergencies and cause alerts to be triggered.

• Sensor state tracking

• Automated alerts (such as Man Down) based on sensor data analysis

• Battery charge monitoring

Location and tracking features

Always-on location tracking is a core component of CTECH Radio operation and in many cases the reason to use the app. Access to location is required by dispatchers for ensuring personnel safety and tracking assets.

• Subscriber identification and location markers

• Detailed street view

• Guard tour planning

• Waypoints

• Indoor localization

Other features

• Remote listening and camera

• Task management and control

Note that the feature set for your particular CTECH Radio setup will be as broad or as lean as your PrioCom administrators configure it to be.

Baresip app can be installed on Android devices running Android version 9 or later. Mobile calling and messaging needs Android version 10 or later. If you need video calling, you can instead of this app install its sister app baresip+.

Today’s Skills.. Tomorrow’s Opportunities

description:
Military-related Algerian phrases for language learners. With Algerian text and audio.

Using this app, you can select an English phrase and view its translation and how to pronounce it in Algerian.

This app was originally developed as an entry to the 2010 CIO/G6 "Apps for the Army" competition, and it is based on the modules publicly available online from the U.S. Defense Language Institute. While this app's subject matter relates mainly to military topics, the app is broadly useful with content relating to a range of topics.

• Contains over 600 phrases with native speaker audio recordings

• Dictionary lookup: Type or say what you want to search

• Pronunciation help: See the transliterated/Romanized text

• Good for language learning, or as a reference

This app is part of a series of phrasebook apps published for many different languages and dialects. Phrasebooks in the series are available as "basic" and "medical" variants.

• Text may be exported as Anki flash cards

• Works offline: No network connection is required

• Search bar for quick vocabulary lookup

• No login or registration needed

• Dark background color minimizes eye strain

Many of the languages covered by this series of phrasebook apps are under-resourced, with translation apps and dictionaries not widely available from other sources.

Categories

Commands, Warnings and Instructions

Helpful Words, Phrases and Questions

Greetings and Introductions

Interrogation

Numbers

Days of the Week/Time

Directions

Locations

Descriptions (Colors, Shapes, Sizes, Tastes, Qualities, Quantities)

Emergency Terms

Food and Sanitation

Fuel and Maintenance

Medical Terms/General

Medical Terms/Parts of the Body

Military Ranks

Lodging

Occupations

Customs (Port of Entry)

Relatives

Weather

General Military Terms

Mine Warfare Terms

How to use

1. Choose a subject category from the menu. That category will be expanded.

2. From the expanded list of phrases shown, tap on the phrase you want.

3. On the phrase detail page, the Algerian phrase is shown alongside its pronunciation and the equivalent English phrase. Press the Play button to hear the audio pronunciation by a native speaker.

Ideal for

• U.S. military service members

• Doctors, nurses, and medical professionals

• Travelers

• Aid workers

• Linguists

Languages and dialects available in this series

Albanian, Algerian, Amharic, Azeri, Baluchi, Bengali, Bosnian, Burmese, Cantonese, Cebuano, Chavacano, Croatian, Czech, Dari, Egyptian, Emirati, French, Gan (Jiangxinese), Georgian, Gujarati, Haitian, Hassaniya, Hausa, Hebrew, Hindi, Igbo, Ilocano, Indonesian (Bahasa), Iraqi, Japanese, Javanese, Jordanian, Kashmiri, Kazakh, Khmer, Korean (North), Kosovar (Albanian), Kurmanji, Kyrgyz, Lebanese, Libyan, Lingala, Malay, Mandarin, Mongolian, Moroccan, Nepali, Palestinian, Pashto (Afghanistan), Pashto (Pakistan), Persian-Farsi, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese (Europe), Punjabi, Quechua, Russian, Saudi, Serbian, Sindhi, Somali, Sorani, Spanish (Colombia), Spanish (Mexico), Spanish (Venezuela), Sudanese, Swahili, Syrian, Tagalog, Tajik, Tamashek, Tamil, Tausug, Telugu, Thai, Tigrinya, Tunisian, Turkish, Turkmen, Uighur, Ukrainian, Urdu, Uzbek, Vietnamese, Shanghainese, Yakan, Yemeni, Yoruba

Making flash cards: Launch app and choose "Flash cards" from the menu in the top corner, and follow the prompts.

Materials in this app are adapted from publications authored by the Defense Language Institute Foreign Language Center (www.dliflc.edu). This app is not affiliated with DLIFLC or any other government or military organization.

description:
Swaddo is a rapidly growing community of parents, educators and caregivers dedicated to improving the care of young children, ultimately enabling them to thrive. We believe that high level care is a fundamental right for all children and we leverage the latest technology to one day achieve and maintain this standard globally.

Features

Swaddo connects parents with all your child’s caregivers such as grandparents, educators, nannies and more. Traditionally, information about your child has been siloed to different groups and this is still true today. The challenge is easily and securely sharing this information among parents and everyone involved with the care of your child.

To address this issue, Swaddo is uniquely built on a messaging platform enabling parents and caregivers to connect easily and share information seamlessly in a secure environment. Information flows continuously making it timely and actionable. For example, enter your child’s sleep, feed and diapers when your child is in your care. While your child is in daycare, continue to track this information as teachers update these activities throughout the day. Over time, you may find that your child’s sleep pattern is not optimal, and this can be discussed meaningfully with your pediatrician. Not only is health and safety vastly improved, overall engagement with your child is enhanced, enabling better decision making and better care.

Features include:

Swaddo App:

Easy signup – Provide an email address, create a password and you’re good to go!

Connect quickly – Immediately connect with registered users in your contact list at the push of a button and invite unregistered contacts via text or email.

Groups – Easily create group threads for ongoing, personalized messaging. Individuals or groups may include family, friends, educators, class parents, nannies, babysitters, pediatricians, absolutely anyone!

Data Storage – All the information related to your child is securely stored on a central database.

Photos – View, download and share photos. Never miss a moment!

Universal Sync – Swaddo automatically stays updated across all your devices like phones and tablets.

Affordable – Great care should never be determined by cost, period. Swaddo’s core features - signing up, connecting, creating groups, messaging, sharing photos, posting activities and more – are completely free. Our enhanced App Yard features for parents, schools, daycares and camps are priced to fit your budget.

For Parents:

Easily create groups for more personalized messaging.

Stay engaged even when your child is in the care of others with real-time messages which include texts, photos, activities, reminders and more.

Access the Daily Sheet feature to view your child’s activities during the school day.

Enter and track your child’s activities such as sleep, feed and diapers. Easily view this information using the Charts feature or simply view your message feed.

Receive timely push notifications and indicators when new messages are posted.

For Educators:

Message Parents – Directly communicate with all the parents in a class or personalize messages to each family.

Check In/Out – Quick, easy and secure check in/out for students and staff.

Attendance – View student and staff attendance on a continually updated timesheet.

Student - Teacher Ratios – Set desired ratios and see them in real-time. Staff is alerted when ratios are not met.

Dashboard – Efficiently manage classes, staff and families.

Daily Sheet – Dynamically generated by Swaddo as educators post activities and messages throughout the school day.

Photos – Take, store and share photos with parents.

While technology can improve elements of childcare, it truly takes the unending resolve of parents, educators and caregivers to make this happen. Together we can improve care and help our young children to thrive. Join us today!

description:
Undertone is private group voice chat for people in the same place — a campsite, a festival crowd, a workshop floor, a road-trip convoy. One person hosts a room, friends join with a 4-digit code or a QR scan, and everyone talks over earbuds: live conversation for up to 8, or push to talk for up to 16. No internet, no phone numbers, no accounts, no servers.

HOW IT WORKS

• Host a room and share the 4-digit code — friends nearby join in seconds

• Join by code, QR scan, or an invite link

• Phones connect directly to each other — on modern Androids there's nothing to set up: no router, no hotspot, no network at all

• On older phones, everyone joins the same Wi-Fi or a hotspot instead — the app tells you which applies

• iPhone friends can join too: Undertone for iPhone is on the App Store, and iPhone and Android can share a room when everyone is on the same Wi-Fi or a phone hotspot

• Works completely offline — in the woods, underground, or anywhere without coverage

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

• Join by QR code and your voice is encrypted between phones

• No account, no sign-up, no personal data collected, no location used

• Nothing passes through a server — your voice travels only between your phones

• Rooms vanish when the host ends them

MADE FOR REAL CONVERSATIONS

• Live conversation or push to talk — hold Talk to speak, see who's talking and who's next, and the host can take the mic

• Voice quality tiers and noise suppression tuned for noisy places

• SoundStage adds natural room ambience so voices don't sound flat

• Save frequent rooms and rejoin them with one tap

• See who's talking at a glance

BUILT FOR LONG SESSIONS

• Battery-aware networking keeps power use low

• Automatic recovery from audio interruptions, route changes, and dropped connections

• Keeps working with the screen off

Direct phone-to-phone connection uses Wi-Fi Aware, available on most recent Android phones (Android 13 and newer with supported hardware). Rooms that include an iPhone use the same Wi-Fi network or a phone hotspot. Push to talk needs Undertone 2.0 on every phone. Undertone is in beta — we'd love your feedback as we expand what it can do.

description:
Korean (North) medical terminology phrases for medical professionals and language learners. With Korean (North) text and audio.

Using this app, you can select an English phrase and view its translation and how to pronounce it in the foreign language.

This app was originally developed as an entry to the 2010 CIO/G6 "Apps for the Army" competition, and it is based on the modules publicly available online from the U.S. Defense Language Institute. While this app's subject matter relates mainly to military topics, the app is broadly useful with content relating to a range of topics.

• Contains over 600 phrases with native speaker audio recordings

• Dictionary-style lookup: Type or say what you want to search

• Pronunciation help: See the transliterated/Romanized text

• Good for language learning, or as a reference

This app is part of a series of phrasebook apps published for many different languages and dialects. Phrasebooks in the series are available as "basic" and "medical" variants.

• Text may be exported as Anki flash cards

• Works offline: No network connection is required

• Search bar for quick vocabulary lookup

• No login or registration needed

• Dark background color minimizes eye strain

Many of the languages covered by this series of phrasebook apps are under-resourced, with translation apps and dictionaries not widely available from other sources.

Introduction

Trauma

How to use

1. Choose a subject category from the menu. That category will be expanded.

2. From the expanded list of phrases shown, tap on the phrase you want.

3. On the phrase detail page, the Korean (North) phrase is shown alongside its pronunciation and the equivalent English phrase. Press the Play button to hear the audio pronunciation by a native speaker.

description:
INS BLE CONFIG

INS BLE CONFIG is a Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) configuration application designed to communicate with ESP32-based reader devices. The app enables users to connect to compatible ESP32 readers using a mobile phone and perform configuration and firmware update tasks efficiently and securely.

The application is intended for device setup, configuration, and maintenance purposes. It works primarily in offline mode and performs all communication locally between the mobile device and the ESP32 reader.

Key Features

• Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) communication with ESP32 readers

• Quick and reliable device discovery and connection

• Reader configuration through a simple mobile interface

• Firmware update (OTA) support using files selected from the device

• Direct firmware upload from mobile phone to ESP32 reader

• No internet connection required for core functionality

• Lightweight and easy-to-use interface

Firmware Update (OTA)

INS BLE CONFIG allows users to update the firmware of ESP32 readers directly from their mobile device. Users can select the firmware file from the device storage using the file manager, and the application transfers the firmware to the reader via Bluetooth.

All firmware update operations are performed locally between the mobile device and the ESP32 reader without uploading data to any external servers.

Permissions Usage

The application may request the following permissions to function correctly:

• Bluetooth / Bluetooth Low Energy – Required to discover, connect, and communicate with ESP32 reader devices.

• File Access / Storage – Required to allow users to select firmware (OTA) files from the device for updating the reader.

These permissions are used strictly for application functionality and not for collecting personal information.

Privacy & Data Safety

INS BLE CONFIG does not collect, store, or share any personal or sensitive user data. The app does not require user registration or login.

All communication occurs locally between the mobile device and the ESP32 reader. No user data or firmware files are transmitted to third-party services or remote servers.

Who Is This App For

INS BLE CONFIG is intended for technicians, installers, and users who need to configure or update ESP32-based reader devices efficiently using a mobile phone.

description:
Aster Mail keeps your messages and personal information secure and private. It is a free encrypted email app with end-to-end encryption, PGP, email aliases, and zero ads.

Aster Mail is built around end-to-end encryption, which means you don't have to trust us with your data, your messages, or your keys. Only you can read your inbox, and we can't even if we tried.

End-to-end encryption

- No one, including us, can read your private messages.

- Messages between Aster users are protected with ML-KEM-768 post-quantum encryption.

- Your mailbox is zero access, so your mail is encrypted at rest and in transit.

- Quantum-safe email encryption protects you today against harvest now, decrypt later attacks.

Aster Mail is forever free

- The free plan is a real free plan with 10 GB and full encryption included.

- You can create multiple aliases to keep your personal identity hidden.

- Email aliases work as disposable, burner, and throwaway addresses for signups.

- If you ever need more, paid plans start only at $2.99 a month.

- Paid plans add custom domain email for your business, your family, or your own name.

Fast, simple, and easy to use

- It's as smooth as Gmail or Outlook, just without any surveillance.

- You get push notifications, dark mode, search, swipe gestures, folders, labels, filters, and multiple identities.

- Schedule send, undo send, snooze, signatures, attachments, and contacts are all built in.

- Add your existing IMAP, SMTP, and POP3 accounts and read every inbox in one mail app.

- Lock the app with a PIN, biometrics, or a passkey, and turn on two-factor authentication.

No trackers, no ads, ever

- You can sign up with just a user name and password without handing over any personal information.

- Your data will never be sold, shared, or monetized.

- Tracking protection blocks spy pixels, read receipts, and remote images before they load.

- The spam filter and phishing protection keep scam mail and junk out of your inbox.

Open source and auditable

- All of our code is open source on our GitHub under AGPL v3 for you to audit and check.

- You can read it, audit it, or submit a pull request yourself.

- You can also download the signed APK straight from our site instead of a store.

Standard OpenPGP for everyone else

- When you email somebody on Gmail, Outlook, or Proton Mail, we use OpenPGP with RSA-4096 and automatic key discovery to encrypt those messages.

- Your keys are portable and work with any other PGP client, such as Thunderbird or GPG.

- Import your old mail in a few taps and switch to a private email address without losing a message.

- If you ever decide to leave Aster, you can take your mail and keys with you. We do not believe in vendor lock-in.

Located in Germany

- Our servers are located in Falkenstein, Germany under Strict GDPR and Privacy Laws.

- Your mail is covered by EU data protection law.

- We publish and update a signed Warrant Canary to keep you updated, as well as a transparency page.

The same secure email everywhere

- Aster Mail also runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, and the web, and your encrypted mailbox syncs across all of them.

- Aster Bridge connects your mailbox to any desktop email client over IMAP and SMTP.

Built to last

- Aster is run by a small, motivated, independent team, and we are not chasing acquisition or venture capital investors.

- We're building an email service that exists and is charging a fair price so we can keep innovating.

description:
Echo is the official English language-skills assessment app from Aditya University, built to measure and strengthen your communication across all four core skills — Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing (LSRW).

Sign in with your university ID and take the assessments assigned to you, anywhere, on your own device. Echo guides you through each section, records your spoken answers, and delivers a clear, structured score report so you always know where you stand.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Listening — Answer questions based on audio passages played inside the app.

• Speaking — Record spoken responses to prompts and topics.

• Reading — Work through comprehension questions and read-aloud tasks.

• Writing — Compose written responses to guided prompts.

FEATURES

• Clean, distraction-free assessment experience designed for students.

• Instant access to your assigned assessments after you sign in.

• Detailed score report with section-wise breakdown and an overall proficiency level.

• Secure, proctored assessments that keep tests fair for everyone.

• Encrypted communication (HTTPS/TLS) and secure on-device sign-in.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Log in with the roll number / user ID issued by Aditya University.

2. Open an assigned assessment and read the guidelines.

3. Complete the Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing sections.

4. Submit and view your results once grading is complete.

MICROPHONE & PRIVACY

Echo requests microphone access only for the Speaking and Reading-aloud sections, and only while an assessment is in progress. Your responses are used solely to evaluate your performance. Echo does not collect your location, contacts, photos or videos. Read our full privacy policy for details.

WHO IT'S FOR

Echo is intended for authorised students, faculty and staff of Aditya University. A valid university account is required to sign in.

Enhanced Communication & Human-Oriented AI — Echo, by Aditya University.

Whether you want to talk with friends, communicate with a group, or join conversations, PushTalk gives you a convenient way to use your phone as an online walkie talkie.

ONLINE WALKIE TALKIE

VOICE CHAT WITH FRIENDS

GROUP VOICE COMMUNICATION

VOICE MESSAGES

When a real-time conversation is not practical, use voice messages as another way to communicate. Record your message and share it through the supported messaging experience instead of typing a longer text.

COMMUNITY COMMUNICATION

WHY USE PUSH TALK?

description:
Tigrinya medical terminology phrases for medical professionals and language learners. With Tigrinya text and audio.

Using this app, you can select an English phrase and view its translation and how to pronounce it in the foreign language.

This app was originally developed as an entry to the 2010 CIO/G6 "Apps for the Army" competition, and it is based on the modules publicly available online from the U.S. Defense Language Institute. While this app's subject matter relates mainly to military topics, the app is broadly useful with content relating to a range of topics.

• Contains over 600 phrases with native speaker audio recordings

• Dictionary-style lookup: Type or say what you want to search

• Pronunciation help: See the transliterated/Romanized text

• Good for language learning, or as a reference

This app is part of a series of phrasebook apps published for many different languages and dialects. Phrasebooks in the series are available as "basic" and "medical" variants.

• Text may be exported as Anki flash cards

• Works offline: No network connection is required

• Search bar for quick vocabulary lookup

• No login or registration needed

• Dark background color minimizes eye strain

Many of the languages covered by this series of phrasebook apps are under-resourced, with translation apps and dictionaries not widely available from other sources.

Categories

Introduction

Guidance

Registration

Assessment

Surgical Consent

Trauma

Procedures

Foley (Catheter)

Surgery Instructions

Pain Interview

Medicine Interview

Orthopedic

Obstetrics/Gynecology

Pediatrics

Cardiology

Ophthalmology

Neurology

Exam Commands

Caregiver

Post-Op/Prognosis

Medical Conditions

Pharmaceutical

Diseases

How to use

1. Choose a subject category from the menu. That category will be expanded.

2. From the expanded list of phrases shown, tap on the phrase you want.

3. On the phrase detail page, the Tigrinya phrase is shown alongside its pronunciation and the equivalent English phrase. Press the Play button to hear the audio pronunciation by a native speaker.

Ideal for

• U.S. Military service members

• Doctors, nurses, and medical professionals

• Travelers

• Aid workers

description:
Recover deleted messages before they disappear forever.

Ever opened a chat and seen "This message was deleted"? With this deleted message recovery app, you can view deleted messages, restore deleted photos and read what was removed — all from your own notification history.

RECOVER DELETED MESSAGES INSTANTLY

The moment a message arrives, this message recovery app saves a private copy on your phone. When the sender deletes it, you get an instant alert and can still read the deleted message. No more guessing what that removed text said.

RECOVER DELETED PHOTOS, VIDEOS AND VOICE NOTES

This is not just a deleted text recovery tool. Recover deleted photos, restore deleted videos, save deleted voice notes, audio files, GIFs, stickers and documents. Full deleted media recovery in one app.

WHAT THIS DELETED MESSAGE RECOVERY APP CAN RESTORE

• Recover deleted messages and deleted texts

• Restore deleted photos and deleted images

• Recover deleted videos and video messages

• Save deleted voice notes and audio messages

• Undelete GIFs, stickers and documents

• View deleted status updates and stories

• Keep a searchable message backup and notification history

HOW MESSAGE RECOVERY WORKS

Messages are encrypted inside your messaging app, so no recovery app can read them directly. Instead, this undelete app builds a private message backup from the notifications your phone already receives. Every incoming message is saved locally, so deleted message recovery works instantly and offline.

NOTIFICATION HISTORY AND MESSAGE BACKUP

Browse your full notification history, search old messages by contact or keyword, and restore deleted chats whenever you need them. Your message backup stays on your device — a private message saver and notification log in one.

KEY FEATURES

• Instant deleted message alerts

• Complete deleted media recovery

• Works with your messaging and social apps

• Fast, lightweight, low battery use

• Search saved messages and recovered files

• Dark mode and simple, clean design

• 100% local storage — nothing uploaded

IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE INSTALLING

Message recovery is a workaround, not an official method, and it has real limits:

Only messages received after install can be recovered. Messages deleted before you installed this app cannot be restored.

Muted chats send no notification, so those deleted messages cannot be saved.

Media must finish downloading before deletion. On a weak connection, deleted photos or videos may be lost.

Android battery optimisation can stop background saving. Please exclude this app in your battery settings.

YOUR PRIVACY COMES FIRST

Your recovered messages never leave your phone. This deleted message recovery app uploads nothing, shares nothing and sells nothing. Notification access is used only to save your own messages locally on your device.

START RECOVERING DELETED MESSAGES TODAY

Install now — recovery only works for messages received after installation, so the sooner you start, the more deleted messages, photos and videos you can restore.

Whether you want to identify an unknown number, discover how your local network interacts, or quickly find essential service numbers, RodCaller is your reliable tool. We built this app with a strong focus on community sourcing and user privacy.

• Smart Caller Identification: Instantly search and identify unknown numbers using our growing community-driven database.

description:
South Africa Radios brings the widest selection of live South African stations in one simple online radio app — listen live to music, news, sports and local programming across Gauteng, Western Cape, KwaZulu‑Natal, Eastern Cape and beyond. Stream stations for work, driving, sport or worship with reliable streaming, quick search and easy tuning for on-demand listening of shows, talk, traffic updates and match commentary. This radio app is built for listeners who want fast access to stations, playlists, local news and live programming without clutter.

Features and benefits: reliable streaming and low data mode for unstable networks; search by city, province, genre or station name; save favourites and resume last station; background play while you use other apps; clear station metadata for show names, DJs and live events; categories for music, talk, news, sports, gospel and community programming. Perfect for commuters in Johannesburg and Pretoria, students in Cape Town, families in Durban and travellers in Port Elizabeth (Gqeberha). Ideal for listening to live soccer commentary, rugby and cricket coverage — follow Kaizer Chiefs, Orlando Pirates, Mamelodi Sundowns, SuperSport United, Stellenbosch FC, Cape Town City, AmaZulu and Springboks match build‑up and post‑match analysis.

Search and discovery: use queries like listen live Johannesburg stations, online radio Cape Town news, streaming Durban talk, listen to Kaizer Chiefs match commentary, Cape Town gospel, Pretoria traffic updates, radio for Afrikaans news, student radio Johannesburg to find exactly what you need. Extensive genre coverage: top 40, hip hop, house, kwaito, gospel, jazz, classical, talk radio, sports commentary, political debate, community shows and religious programming including praise, sermons and daily devotionals.

Stations and cities covered include major national and regional broadcasters and many local favourites to maximise discovery: 702 (Johannesburg‑Gauteng), 94.7 (Joburg), 5FM (national), Metro FM (national), Kaya FM (Johannesburg), Jacaranda FM (Pretoria), East Coast Radio (Durban‑KZN), KFM 94.5 (Cape Town‑WC), CapeTalk (Cape Town), Gagasi (Durban), Ukhozi FM (KZN), Umhlobo Wenene (Eastern Cape), Lesedi FM (Free State), Thobela FM (Limpopo), YFM (Joburg), Radio 2000 (national), SAfm (national), RSG (Afrikaans), Channel Africa (international), Lotus FM (KZN), Good Hope FM (Cape Town), Smile 90.4 (Cape Town), OFM (Bloemfontein/Free State), Radio Pulpit (national), Voice of the Cape, Vuma 103, Radio Tygerberg, Radio Islam, Classic FM SA, Smile FM, East Cape stations, North West community stations, Limpopo regional channels and many more local streams across Johannesburg, Cape Town, Durban, Pretoria, Polokwane, Nelspruit (Mbombela), Bloemfontein, Kimberley and Gqeberha.

Why choose this app: tailored search for local news and sport, broad music selection from house to gospel, dependable streams for live shows and match days, lightweight design for fast tuning, and the convenience of saving favourites and sharing stations. Whether you want morning talk in Afrikaans, live traffic in Pretoria, Cape Town jazz nights, Durban gospel services, or live soccer commentary for Kaizer Chiefs vs Orlando Pirates, find it fast. If you follow cricket or rugby, tune to match previews, live commentary and post‑game analysis from national and community broadcasters.

description:
Kindly is a calm social space — for staying close to the friends you already have, and for meeting new people slowly, without swipe culture.

Two modes, one philosophy: depth over noise. No ads, no algorithms deciding who deserves your attention.

─── STAY CLOSE ───

Built for the friendships you actually maintain.

✨ Glows — share how you feel, quietly

A 12-mood emotional broadcast that fades on its own. Friends can sit with your mood without saying anything. No pressure to perform.

🌌 Your Constellation

Your friends become your night sky. Core, Close, Everyone — each circle illuminates your stars. Tap to talk.

🪟 Around Now

Light a one-hour lantern when you're free. Your close friends see a soft signal. No always-on, no perpetual "online".

🔥 Streaks

Daily, weekly, or monthly habits. Pick friends to root for you with quiet pings. No leaderboards, no shame.

📅 Calendar that knows your culture

Hari Raya, Deepavali, Wesak, Christmas, Holi, Yom Kippur, Mid-Autumn — every region's actual holidays, country-aware. Not a Western default.

💬 Real chat

Voice messages, photos, files, reactions, replies. Read receipts you can turn off. Disappearing messages. Tone Check before you send something hot.

📖 Day Story

A private journal that gathers your day automatically. Add a reflection if you want. Share with close friends or keep it just for you.

─── MEET SLOWLY (Spark Premium) ───

For new connections — the opposite of every swipe app you've used.

✉️ Slow Sparks — letters before face

Pick a stranger from their words, not their selfies. Photos stay blurred until you each send three letters. The face becomes the payoff, not the gate.

🎙️ Voice Letters

Hear them before you see them. Thirty seconds, their actual voice. The most honest first impression a stranger can give.

💫 Mood Twin

When your mood is "thoughtful" and someone else just lit theirs the same way — you both find out. Real-time emotional resonance.

📜 Letter Vault

Every meaningful exchange, archived forever. Search a name, revisit a thread, find the line that mattered a year ago.

🛡️ Identity Floor

Every Slow Sparks profile discloses age, gender, what they're looking for, and relationship status before you write. No catfish. No vague vibes.

💛 Mutual Filter

You only see people whose looking-for includes you, and whose gender is in yours. No dead-end matches.

─── WHAT WE DON'T DO ───

• No ads, ever

• No third-party tracking

• No algorithm deciding who deserves your attention

• No "engagement at any cost" patterns

• No swipe culture, no superlikes, no boosts to be seen

Light + dark themes. Support for 100+ languages.

Kindly isn't trying to maximize your swipes. It's trying to maximize the chance that your next conversation actually means something.

Built with care, designed for depth.

description:
The Campus Crime Stoppers & Friends for Life of Tarrant County app is a school safety technology that allows students, parents, and community members to submit secure & anonymous safety concerns in Tarrant County schools. Secure intel, ongoing two-way dialog, and photo and video upload features sent to the Crime Stoppers of Tarrant County Call Center enable school personnel and law enforcement to receive the most accurate information in order to create effective interventions and prevent violence and tragedies.

Campus Crime Stoppers of Tarrant County takes tips regarding unsolved crimes, drugs, theft, weapon possession, vandalism, graffiti, assault, arson, school violations, and other disruptive and dangerous activities occurring in a Tarrant County school.

Friends for Life is a resource for students who want to report fellow students who are victims of bullying, cyber bullying, sexting, dating violence, family violence, gang activity, sexual harassment, or contemplating suicide.

description:
Bengali medical terminology phrases for medical professionals and language learners. With Bengali text and audio.

Using this app, you can select an English phrase and view its translation and how to pronounce it in the foreign language.

This app was originally developed as an entry to the 2010 CIO/G6 "Apps for the Army" competition, and it is based on the modules publicly available online from the U.S. Defense Language Institute. While this app's subject matter relates mainly to military topics, the app is broadly useful with content relating to a range of topics.

• Contains over 600 phrases with native speaker audio recordings

• Dictionary-style lookup: Type or say what you want to search

• Pronunciation help: See the transliterated/Romanized text

• Good for language learning, or as a reference

This app is part of a series of phrasebook apps published for many different languages and dialects. Phrasebooks in the series are available as "basic" and "medical" variants.

• Text may be exported as Anki flash cards

• Works offline: No network connection is required

• Search bar for quick vocabulary lookup

• No login or registration needed

• Dark background color minimizes eye strain

Many of the languages covered by this series of phrasebook apps are under-resourced, with translation apps and dictionaries not widely available from other sources.

Categories

Introduction

Guidance

Registration

Assessment

Surgical Consent

Trauma

Procedures

Foley (Catheter)

Surgery Instructions

Medicine Interview

Orthopedic

Pediatrics

Cardiology

Ophthalmology

Neurology

Exam Commands

Caregiver

Post-Op/Prognosis

Medical Conditions

Pharmaceutical

Diseases

How to use

1. Choose a subject category from the menu. That category will be expanded.

2. From the expanded list of phrases shown, tap on the phrase you want.

3. On the phrase detail page, the Bengali phrase is shown alongside its pronunciation and the equivalent English phrase. Press the Play button to hear the audio pronunciation by a native speaker.

Ideal for

• U.S. Military service members

• Doctors, nurses, and medical professionals

• Travelers

• Aid workers

• Linguists

Languages and dialects available in this series

Albanian, Algerian, Amharic, Azeri, Baluchi, Bengali, Bosnian, Burmese, Cantonese, Cebuano, Chavacano, Croatian, Czech, Dari, Egyptian, Emirati, French, Gan (Jiangxinese), Georgian, Gujarati, Haitian, Hassaniya, Hausa, Hebrew, Hindi, Igbo, Ilocano, Indonesian (Bahasa), Iraqi, Japanese, Javanese, Jordanian, Kashmiri, Kazakh, Khmer, Korean (North), Kosovar (Albanian), Kurmanji, Kyrgyz, Lebanese, Libyan, Lingala, Malay, Mandarin, Mongolian, Moroccan, Nepali, Palestinian, Pashto (Afghanistan), Pashto (Pakistan), Persian-Farsi, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese (Europe), Punjabi, Quechua, Russian, Saudi, Serbian, Sindhi, Somali, Sorani, Spanish (Colombia), Spanish (Mexico), Spanish (Venezuela), Sudanese, Swahili, Syrian, Tagalog, Tajik, Tamashek, Tamil, Tausug, Telugu, Thai, Tigrinya, Tunisian, Turkish, Turkmen, Uighur, Ukrainian, Urdu, Uzbek, Vietnamese, Shanghainese, Yakan, Yemeni, Yoruba
